profiles.name: Dream Dwarf
speciesTraits: Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution and −2 Dexterity. Base land speed 20 ft., retained in medium or heavy armor and under a medium or heavy load.
Darkvision sees in black and white out to 90 ft.

Stonecunning gives +2 racial on Search checks for unusual stonework, including material disguised as stone. A Dream Dwarf who comes within 10 ft. of unusual stonework can make a Search check as if actively looking.
Stonecunning also lets the dwarf Search for stonework traps as a rogue can and estimate approximate depth underground.
Weapon Familiarity treats dwarven waraxes and dwarven urgroshes as martial weapons.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.
+2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks with creatures of the earth subtype.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.

Spell Power adds +1 to effective caster level for divinations or spells with the earth descriptor when in contact with the ground. Apply the increase to level-dependent effects and caster level checks. It stacks with other Spell Power abilities.
Common and Dwarven are automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Terran, and Undercommon. Favored class Druid. The entry lists no racial Hit Dice or level adjustment.

npcBuilds.name: Maera Dol-Vel

build.title: Dream Dwarf spring tender, Druid 1
skills: Concentration +7, or +11 to cast defensively or while grappled or pinned
Diplomacy +4, or +6 with creatures of the earth subtype
traits: Hide armor +3 and heavy wooden shield +2. Touch 10, flat-footed 15. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +0, Will +4.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Stonecunning checks unusual stonework within 10 ft. and covers stonework traps. Combat Casting grants +4 on qualifying Concentration checks. Nature Sense is included in Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild Empathy +1. Animal companion slot open.

Spell Power adds +1 to effective caster level for divinations or spells with the earth descriptor when in contact with the ground. Apply the increase to level-dependent effects and caster level checks. It stacks with other Spell Power abilities.
actions: Prepared 0-level spells are detect magic, detect poison, and light. Prepared 1st-level spells are entangle and speak with animals. Spontaneously convert a prepared spell to summon nature’s ally of the same level when available.

On the ground, detect magic and detect poison use caster level 2, and speak with animals lasts 2 minutes. At base caster level 1, speak with animals lasts 1 minute. Detect poison has 30-ft. range on the ground and 25-ft. range at caster level 1.

Entangle uses caster level 1 in either case. Plants in a 40-ft.-radius spread within 440 ft. entangle creatures on a failed Reflex DC 13. Successful saves still limit movement to half speed. The effect lasts 1 minute.
build.tactics: Maera wants to know why animals have stopped drinking at the spring. She speaks with a badger from the bank and uses detect poison on the spillway. If pursued, she falls back through the reeds and casts entangle to slow the approach.

npcBuilds.motive: Find out why the animals no longer drink from the uphill spring.
npcBuilds.hook: Maera can speak with a badger from the bank while the party checks the spillway for what changed.

npcBuilds.name: Ornek Tarn-Iol

build.title: Dream Dwarf seam reader, Expert 1
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Dream Sight (Su) sees ethereal creatures as readily as material creatures. Ethereal creatures look translucent and indistinct, so the dwarf can tell them apart.
Stability adds +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while standing firmly on the ground.

Each listed Expert class skill has four ranks. Skill Focus (Search) adds +3. Stonecunning adds another +2 when checking unusual stonework, including a stonework trap. A search is possible within 10 ft. even without actively looking.
actions: Light crossbow +1 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
build.tactics: Ornek surveys a bricked-up passage after glimpsing an ethereal traveler through its entrance. He marks the seam for the party and uses ordinary tools to check the wall.

npcBuilds.motive: Identify the old exit an ethereal traveler crossed just before a tunnel was bricked up.
npcBuilds.hook: Ornek can identify an unusual seam in the new stonework if the party brings the old floor plan.
